assessment: All 99 final pages are covered by the complete baseline visual review plus full-page inspection of every changed page in both layout passes. Both material figure/statement interruptions are closed. No remaining material visual layout issue was found.
scope: Visual layout and reading-flow review only; this report does not add a fresh proof audit or formal-coverage claim.
page_number_convention: Physical page 1 is the cover; physical 2–4 are roman i–iii; physical 5 begins printed page 1. Printed page equals physical minus 4 thereafter.

coverage.note: The baseline was personally inspected in all 25 contact sheets; full-page views were split between this reviewer and the supplementary reviewer. Every changed page was reopened at full-page original image detail. Unchanged pages were carried forward only after exact RGB pixel comparisons at 120 dpi. Rendering alone was not counted as a visual inspection.

Coverage distinguishes personal contact/full-page inspection from the supplementary reviewer. Rendering alone is not counted as visual inspection. All six main figures, the formal ledger, dense mathematical sections, and all 24 atlas plates received full-page inspection.

method.skill: PDF inspection skill; read-only use, no authoring marker invoked
method.rendering: All 99 baseline pages rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 120 dpi, 1020×1320 px. Contact sheets use four pages per image except the final three-page sheet. Supplementary reviewer rendered physical 40–79 at 144 dpi, 1224×1584 px.
visual_checks: Text and formula containment and clipping
Mathematical glyph, subscript, and superscript readability
Overlap, accidental blank pages, and page-boundary flow
Placement of figures relative to statements and proofs
method.scope: Visual layout review. No new claim of proof verification or formal coverage follows from this report.

findings.title: Figure 5 interrupts the statement of Theorem 21.3
findings.description: Theorem 21.3 begins near the bottom of physical page 49 with Suppose and a commutative square. A full-page Figure 5 occupies physical page 50. The theorem resumes at the top of physical page 51 with is a commuting square. Then. The inserted figure splits one theorem statement and sentence.
findings.source_boundary: Immediately after the Figure 5 environment, before the theorem carrying label thm:obstruction_naturality (baseline source around lines 943–950).
findings.minimal_repair: Flush Figure 5 before Theorem 21.3; insert a clearpage after the figure environment and before the theorem, rebuild, then inspect the affected pages.
findings.mathematical_implication: None. This is a layout/readability finding, not a proof or statement defect.
findings.disposition: Root applied a clearpage after the Figure 5 environment. Final closure confirmed by the visual review and final pixel-comparison chain.
findings.resolution: Figure 5 is flushed before Theorem 21.3. Physical page 49 ends after complete Theorem 21.2 material, Figure 5 occupies 50, and all of Theorem 21.3 and its proof are together on 51. These repaired pages were visually inspected in the first layout pass and are pixel-identical in the final PDF.

findings.title: Reflow moves Figure 6 inside Theorem 27.8
findings.description: Physical page 70 starts Theorem 27.8, Convergence of sampled transports, and ends its theorem box after the display U_pi -> U(T). Physical page 71 is the full-page Figure 6. Physical page 72 resumes the same theorem box with in operator norm. There is a constant C, followed by the error-bound display. Thus the theorem statement itself is interrupted by an entire figure page.
findings.baseline_context: In the original reviewed baseline the full theorem statement and proof preceded Figure 6. The Figure 5 layout repair reflowed this later statement across Figure 6.
findings.minimal_repair: Flush Figure 6 after its figure environment and before Theorem 27.8, for example with a clearpage there; rebuild and inspect all changed pages, especially the 27.8 statement and proof.
findings.disposition: Root applied a clearpage after the Figure 6 environment. All three changed final pages were visually inspected and the remaining 96 pages matched the reviewed prior rendering exactly.
findings.scope: Visual reading-flow defect only; no mathematical defect is inferred.
findings.resolution: Figure 6 is flushed before Theorem 27.8. Physical page 70 ends after the complete Theorem 27.7 proof and key-idea callout. Figure 6 occupies 71. Physical page 72 now contains all of Theorem 27.8, its operator-norm qualification and error bound, and its entire proof. Physical page 73 has a clean direct proof continuation and concluding section.

observations: No remaining visible text or formula clipping, overlap, missing-glyph boxes, or unreadable mathematical glyphs was found at the inspected scales.
No accidental blank page was found. Short section-boundary pages, dedicated figure pages, and the appendix introduction are intentional.
All six main figures, the formal ledger, dense mathematical sections, and all 24 atlas plates received full-page visual review.
Section 17 Figure 4 remains between complete mathematical material and the following norm proposition; its reviewed pages are unchanged in both later passes.

All atlas pages were inspected at full-page scale. The three first-pass atlas changes at physical pages 78,95,96 were confined to page-locator digits. Their full diagrams, matrices, tables, labels, and captions remain readable, and all atlas pages are pixel-identical between the first and final layout passes.
Ordinary direct page continuations of theorem statements or proofs were not treated as defects. The two resolved findings inserted an entire figure page inside a single statement.

supplementary_geometry.note: Text extraction and bounding boxes supplement, and do not replace, visual inspection.
